summary: Real-code-cited root-cause evidence, the measurement-first backpressure design, and direct compiled-binary proof for the speech pipeline backlog fix and its three converging secondary fixes.
trigger: Operator's real Windows report after Phase 3.8.7.2's worker-thread decoupling fix: transcription active, audio arriving (input signal 4-7%), but CIP still became slow over extended listening, transcript remained poor/repetitive, Intelligence Feed stayed empty, NO SIGNAL still occurred intermittently, and the build showed '61c80a... + uncommitted changes' needing verification. The operator's own hypothesis: the speech queue is likely unbounded and Whisper can fall behind real-time audio.

baselineConfirmation.workingTree: clean at audit start (git status --porcelain, 0 lines)

finding1_inferenceCounterStillWrong.citation: apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/commands.rs (pre-fix, then line ~1343): diag.inferences_attempted += 1 ran unconditionally for every chunk fed to a ready engine, not only the ~1-in-300 calls where WhisperSpeechEngine::feed_audio's internal buffer (ai/speech/src/whisper.rs's CHUNK_SAMPLES, ~3.0s) actually crossed its threshold and called run_inference()/whisper.cpp's real full().
finding1_inferenceCounterStillWrong.confirmedNotFixedByPriorPhase: Phase 3.8.7.1 fixed a different failure mode (the not-ready-engine over-count, chunks_skipped_engine_not_ready) - this is a distinct bug in the ready-engine path, never touched by that fix.
finding1_inferenceCounterStillWrong.fix: New default SpeechEngine::last_feed_triggered_inference() -> bool trait method (core/ai/src/speech_engine.rs), false by default, overridden by WhisperSpeechEngine to report whether its most recent feed_audio call actually ran run_inference(). handle_audio_chunk checks this after feed_audio and only increments inferences_attempted/duration counters/inferences_succeeded when true.

finding2_unboundedQueueConfirmed.citation: apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/commands.rs (pre-fix, start_listening): let (speech_tx, speech_rx) = mpsc::channel::<AudioChunk>(); - plain std::sync::mpsc::channel, no bound, confirmed by reading the literal source, not inferred.
finding2_unboundedQueueConfirmed.measuredConsequence: At 480 samples/callback @ 48,000 Hz (the operator's own real device, from their diagnostics screenshots), each AudioChunk represents 10ms of audio arriving roughly every 10ms (~100/sec), ~1KB per queued chunk including allocator overhead. Whisper's inference window is 3.0s of audio; if a single state.full() call takes materially longer than 3.0 wall-clock seconds on a modest CPU (plausible for tiny.en alongside OBS/vMix/PowerPoint), the backlog grows by the excess duration every inference cycle, compounding without bound over a 20-30 minute service.
finding2_unboundedQueueConfirmed.fix: A shared pending_ms: Arc<AtomicU64> tracks wall-clock duration (not raw chunk count, since chunk size/rate varies by device) of audio queued but not yet fed to the engine. start_listening's sink closure increments it on send; spawn_speech_worker decrements it (saturating, via a lock-free CAS loop - saturating_sub_u64) on dequeue. When the remaining backlog crosses OVERLOAD_THRESHOLD_MS (10,000ms), the worker drains and discards the entire backlog (rx.try_recv() until empty) plus WhisperSpeechEngine's own internal buffer (new SpeechEngine::discard_buffered_audio() trait method) rather than grinding through an ever-more-stale FIFO.
finding2_unboundedQueueConfirmed.designRejected: A plain bounded sync_channel/try_send-drop-newest design (Option A alone) was explicitly rejected: it would still leave the worker forever walking through an ever-more-stale FIFO once full, never catching up to live audio - directly contrary to the operator's own instruction not to simply swap unbounded-for-bounded and declare victory, and their requirement to prefer real-time audio over minutes-old backlog.

finding3_statusPollLockContentionConfirm.citation: Four call sites re-grepped fresh: get_pilot_diagnostics (line ~472), start_listening (~1003), stop_listening (~1051), get_live_status (~5068) - all called state.speech_engine.lock()...is_ready(), the same mutex handle_audio_chunk holds for the full duration of a blocking whisper.cpp inference call.
finding3_statusPollLockContentionConfirm.keyFact: is_ready() is provably constant after construction for both existing engines: WhisperSpeechEngine::is_ready() always returns true (hardcoded), NullSpeechEngine::is_ready() always returns false. AppState.speech_engine is never reassigned after construction (all 5 uses are either the one-time AppState::new construction or a .lock()... read).
finding3_statusPollLockContentionConfirm.fix: New plain (non-Mutex) AppState.speech_ready: bool field, computed once in AppState::new before the engine moves into its Mutex. All four call sites replaced with state.speech_ready - zero lock contention, zero behavior change.

finding4_staleWorkerRaceConfirmed.description: A speech worker still finishing a blocking feed_audio call when stop_listening runs (whisper.cpp exposes no cancellation API) can emit output a moment after a fresh start_listening has begun a new session, since active_service does not change across a listening restart within the same service.
finding4_staleWorkerRaceConfirmed.severity: Low - not a deadlock, not data corruption (the old worker's segment is a real transcript of real audio, correctly attributed) - but could read as confusing stale content appearing in a perceived-new session.
finding4_staleWorkerRaceConfirmed.fix: New AppState.listening_generation: AtomicU64 (starts at 0), incremented once per start_listening attempt. spawn_speech_worker/handle_audio_chunk carry the generation value at spawn time; before emitting/persisting any non-empty result, the current AppState.listening_generation is compared - a mismatch discards the result. Deliberately not gated on stop_listening alone (a plain stop-without-restart still surfaces its last few real seconds of speech).

measurementDrivenDesign: Per the operator's explicit instruction ('do not replace the queue until measurements demonstrate the actual overload behavior' / 'do not simply replace the unbounded queue with a bounded queue and declare victory'), the backpressure design was derived from the operator's own real measured chunk rate (480 samples @ 48kHz = 10ms/chunk) and reasoned consequences, documented in docs/phase-3-8-7-3-audit.md before any code was written.
newDiagnosticsAdded: queue_pending_ms / queue_high_water_ms - current and session-peak backlog depth in milliseconds of queued audio
overload_events / audio_ms_dropped_overload - count of drain episodes and total audio discarded across them (never hidden)

last_inference_duration_ms / max_inference_duration_ms / avg_inference_duration_ms (derived) - real whisper.cpp state.full() call duration, measured with std::time::Instant, gated on last_feed_triggered_inference() so only real inferences are counted
last_transcript_pipeline_duration_ms - total handle_final_transcript duration (DB persistence + Bible detection + suggestions), wrapped with Instant at the commands.rs call site
overload_state (normal/busy/falling_behind/overloaded) - derived at read time from queue_pending_ms against fixed thresholds (classify_overload), never stored redundantly
